shards.note: The supplemental source is compact and application-specific, so one shard covers the complete metadata and README plus structural checks reported by dataset-scout. No flight CSV is copied into the lesson in this rescope.
shards.pdf_pages: not applicable; Dataverse metadata, Markdown README, and CSV records

notes: Immutable anchor: DOI 10.18710/U4TLYV, Version 1.0, and per-file MD5. Collection took place 2023-05-08 at Agdenes Airfield, Norway, in strong northwesterly wind with a significant vertical component. IMU, GPS, propulsion, and command channels were manually synchronized and resampled to 40 Hz; that processing limits exact delay claims.
